name: feather
description: feather monorepo：engine（主线程）+ shell（Worker）+ 共享 @box vendor

scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @feather/protocol typecheck && pnpm --filter @feather/transport typecheck && pnpm --filter feather-shell typecheck && pnpm --filter feather-engine typecheck && pnpm --filter @feather/daemon typecheck
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @feather/protocol build && pnpm --filter @feather/transport build && pnpm --filter feather-shell build && pnpm --filter feather-engine build && pnpm --filter @feather/daemon build
scripts.test:daemon: pnpm --filter @feather/daemon build && pnpm --filter @feather/daemon check:shard-policy && pnpm --filter @feather/daemon check:map-config && pnpm --filter @feather/daemon check:volume && pnpm --filter @feather/daemon check:stats && pnpm --filter @feather/daemon check:shard && pnpm --filter @feather/daemon check:daemon && pnpm --filter @feather/daemon check:restart && pnpm --filter @feather/daemon check:content-arena && pnpm --filter @feather/daemon check:workspace && pnpm --filter feather-engine check:script-timeout-policy && pnpm --filter feather-engine check:shared-content-arena && pnpm --filter feather-engine check:content-host-cache
